1. Who we are

Thumbless ("the Service", "we", "us") is provided by [TODO: legal entity name], [TODO: registered address], contact hasib107040@gmail.com.

By installing or using the Service you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not install it, and uninstall it if you already have.

2. What the Service does

Thumbless is a browser extension that advances to the next short video on short-video feeds after the current video finishes playing — on the feeds it supports out of the box, and on any other site you choose to turn it on for. Mobile and TV applications are in development and are not published; when they are, these Terms will cover them too.

What it will never do. The Service cannot like, comment, reply, follow, subscribe, share, save, react, message, report, or make purchases on your behalf. This is not a setting — there is no code path capable of it, and every action passes through a policy guard that permits only forward navigation. We consider this a core promise of the product and we will not add such capabilities.

3. Your relationship with the sites you use it on

The Service acts on your behalf, on sites you are already using, in a browser you control. It does not access those sites on our servers and it holds no account with them.

You are responsible for complying with the terms of service of any website or application you use the Service on. Some platforms restrict automated interaction. We do not warrant that using the Service is permitted by any third-party platform, and we are not responsible for any action a platform takes against your account there.

We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Google, or any other platform. All trademarks belong to their owners.

4. Accounts

Some features, in editions that offer them, require an account. The currently published edition has no accounts at all. Where an account exists, you agree to:

  • provide an email address you control;
  • keep your password confidential;
  • tell us promptly at hasib107040@gmail.com if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission.

You must be at least 16 years old, or the age of digital consent in your country if higher, to create an account.

We may suspend or terminate an account that is used to break these Terms, to attempt to circumvent payment, or in a way that harms the Service or other users. Where we reasonably can, we will tell you why.

5. Subscriptions, billing and renewal

Paid plans are described at [TODO: pricing page URL]. The price shown at the time of purchase is the price you pay for that term.

  • Recurring plans renew automatically at the end of each term at the then-current price until cancelled. You may cancel at any time; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid term, and you keep access until then.
  • Lifetime plans, where offered, are a single payment granting access for as long as the Service is operated. See §11.
  • The free trial takes no payment details and never converts into a charge by itself. When it ends, the Service stops advancing videos until you subscribe; your settings are kept.
  • Payments are processed by [TODO: merchant of record], who acts as merchant of record and is the seller of record for the transaction. Their terms also apply to it.
  • Prices exclude any taxes unless stated. The merchant of record collects and remits applicable VAT/sales tax.

Price changes. We may change subscription prices. We will give at least 30 days' notice by email before a change affects your renewal, and you may cancel before it takes effect. A lifetime plan already purchased is not affected.

Refunds and the statutory right of withdrawal are covered in a separate document: Refund & Cancellation Policy, which forms part of these Terms.

You may not:

7. Your data

Our handling of personal data is described in the Privacy Policy, which forms part of these Terms.

In summary: the Service does not read, store or transmit the content of the videos you watch. The published trial edition sends nothing off your device at all. Anonymous reliability telemetry exists only in builds configured with our backend, is off by default, and is optional there.

8. Availability and changes to the Service

We aim to keep the Service working, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted availability.

Supported sites change without notice. When a platform changes how its site works, the Service may stop functioning there until we publish a compatibility update. We will make reasonable efforts to restore support promptly, but we cannot guarantee that any particular site will remain supported, and a platform may make support impossible.

We may add, change or remove features. If we remove a feature that was material to a paid plan you are on, you may cancel and request a pro-rata refund of the unused portion of your current term.

9. Disclaimers and limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the Service is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, our total liability arising out of or relating to the Service is limited to the greater of (a) the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the event giving rise to the claim, or (b) USD 50. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, or for lost profits or data.

Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law — including death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or, where you are a consumer, your statutory rights.

10. Indemnity

You agree to indemnify us against claims arising from your breach of these Terms or your misuse of the Service. This does not apply to consumers to the extent prohibited by law.

11. "Lifetime" plans — what that means

A lifetime plan grants access for as long as we operate the Service. It is not a promise that the Service will be operated forever, and it does not survive the Service being discontinued.

If we discontinue the Service entirely, we will give at least 90 days' notice by email and, for lifetime purchases made within the preceding 12 months, offer a pro-rata refund. We state this plainly because "lifetime" is otherwise a word that misleads.
